layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout. Sidebar fixed left. Main content flex-1 with max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-8.
layouts.worker_dashboard: Top navigation bar layout for mobile-friendly self-service portal. Main content max-w-5xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-8.
layouts.cards: Subtle Neumorphism. bg-white shadow-sm border border-slate-100 rounded-xl p-6. Internal padding must be generous.
layouts.tables: Grid Borders. border-collapse, w-full text-left. th with border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 text-sm font-medium py-3 px-4. td with border-b border-slate-100 py-3 px-4 text-slate-700.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with crisp transitions. transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. rounded-md border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 focus:border-indigo-500. Always provide labels.
components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border

motion.hover: Subtle translation (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase on cards. Background tint change on table rows.
motion.transitions: Specific properties only: transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-shadow duration-200 ease-out.

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react for all standard UI icons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
Do not center align the app container, do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure contrast ratio requirements are met (APCA/WCAG AA).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under text. Use glass-morphism or solid bg.
Always set explicit focus states for accessibility.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
Use currency symbol ₹ correctly everywhere money is displayed.
Create robust data grids/tables for attendance tracking and payment records.
Ensure mobile-friendliness, especially for the worker self-service portal.
